name: Chime of Opening

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Strike the chime
powers.text: Point it at a locked door, chest or shackles within 120 ft and strike it: one lock or latch opens (10 uses).

summary: 10 uses: one lock, bar or latch on something within 120 ft springs open.
text: A hollow metal tube roughly 1 foot long and weighing 1 pound. Strike it as a Magic action while aiming it at a door, lid, lock or other openable object within 120 feet. Its clear note unfastens one lock or latch on that object, provided the sound can reach it; if nothing locked or latched remains, the object itself swings open. It works 10 times, then cracks and is useless.
